subject.title: Bug: Web UI session context not preserved after restart — model can't see history that UI displays

question: Should the linked fix narrow WebChat session reuse to an explicit first-send/reconnect restore path before this issue can close?
rationale: The bug is real against the documented WebChat contract, but the active fix candidate changes session freshness semantics, so maintainer intent is needed before accepting or narrowing that behavior.

options.title: Narrow The Linked Fix
options.body: Keep this issue open while the linked PR is repaired so only the intended restore send suppresses stale rollover.

options.title: Accept Visible-Session Override
options.body: Approve and document that a displayed WebChat session should continue even when idle/daily freshness would otherwise rotate it.

options.title: Replace With Restore UX
options.body: Close or pause the candidate PR and solve this with an explicit stale-session restore/disclosure flow instead.

recommendation.title: Narrow The Linked Fix
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while the linked PR is repaired so only the intended restore send suppresses stale rollover.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged one-shot reconnect/session freshness boundary that the open candidate fix is modifying.
